title: Data Solution Architect
description:
Key Roles & Responsibilities 1. End-to-End Solution Architecture Own solution architecture and design from source ingestion through Bronze, Silver and Gold layers to final consumption. Work with business and technical stakeholders to understand functional and non-functional requirements. Translate business requirements into scalable data architectures, implementation patterns and engineering designs. Determine the most appropriate architecture and technology based on performance, scalability, security, cost, maintainability and operational complexity. Evaluate alternative designs and determine the appropriate processing and orchestration approach across AWS, Snowflake, Apache Airflow and other approved platform components. Ensure solutions support current reporting and analytics requirements while also making enterprise data ready for scalable downstream AI consumption where required. Define reusable architecture patterns and avoid isolated solutions where common platform capabilities can be established. 2. Bronze, Silver & Gold Layer Ownership Define architecture, design principles and standards for Bronze, Silver and Gold layers. Determine what data should be captured, standardized, cleansed, transformed and modeled at each layer. Define appropriate patterns for full load, incremental load, CDC, MERGE, SCD, historization, deduplication, reconciliation and retention. Determine the appropriate consumption layer based on business and technical requirements rather than creating unnecessary Gold datasets. Ensure Silver and Gold datasets contain the appropriate business context, relationships, quality and history required by downstream consumers. 
 DATA SOLUTION ARCHITECT | JOB DESCRIPTION 
 Confidential • 2 
 Ensure datasets required for AI use cases are appropriately structured, standardized, contextualized, modeled and governed before being made available for downstream AI consumption. Design the layers to maximize reuse across reporting, analytics and AI requirements, minimizing duplicate processing and datasets. 3. Data Modeling Own conceptual, logical and physical data modeling for enterprise data solutions. Define the appropriate dimensional, relational and analytical modeling approach for each requirement. Establish standards for facts, dimensions, data grain, business keys, surrogate keys, relationships, common dimensions and historical tracking. Define appropriate SCD and historization approaches based on business requirements. Ensure consistent business definitions and reusable models across different solutions. Design models capable of serving reporting, analytics and AI consumption requirements without unnecessary duplication. Ensure consumption-ready datasets contain the necessary business context and relationships for reliable downstream usage. Review and approve data models produced by implementation teams before development and production deployment. 4. Engineering & Production Standards Ensure every solution appropriately addresses: Data quality and validation Schema-change management Source-to-target reconciliation Metadata and data lineage Record-count reconciliation Scheduling and dependency management Duplicate and rejected-record handling Security and role-based access Error and exception management SLA/SLO requirements Retry, restart and reprocessing mechanisms Performance and scalability Logging and auditability Automated testing Pipeline monitoring and alerting CI/CD and environment promotion Failure email/notification mechanisms Production support and operational 
 documentation 
 The Solution Architect will ensure these requirements are incorporated into the solution design from the beginning rather than being addressed after development. 5. Technology Selection & Architecture Optimization Evaluate and recommend the most appropriate technology and implementation approach for each requirement. Have strong architectural knowledge of Snowflake capabilities, including Snowpipe, Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables, stored procedures and Iceberg. Have strong knowledge of relevant AWS services, including Amazon S3, AWS Glue, Glue Data Catalog, Lambda, IAM and Amazon MWAA/Apache Airflow. Determine where ingestion, storage, transformation and orchestration should occur across AWS, Snowflake and associated technologies based on architectural suitability. Consider downstream consumption through Snowflake Cortex and Azure-based data/AI capabilities when designing datasets expected to support AI use cases. Ensure these datasets are structured and modeled appropriately for scalable downstream AI consumption. 
 DATA SOLUTION ARCHITECT | JOB DESCRIPTION 
 Confidential • 3 
 Identify inefficient, overly complex or costly implementations and recommend improvements. Continuously optimize performance, compute utilization, data movement, storage, scalability and cost. Reduce unnecessary duplication and establish reusable platform capabilities wherever appropriate. Periodically review existing architecture to identify opportunities for modernization, simplification and optimization. 6. Architecture Governance & Design Review Act as the technical design authority for enterprise data solutions. Conduct architecture and solution-design reviews before implementation. Review designs created by engineering teams, implementation partners and other technology teams. Challenge solutions where scalability, maintainability, security, reliability, performance, cost or operational readiness have not been sufficiently addressed. Ensure designs comply with established architectural, data-modeling and engineering standards. Ensure major architecture decisions and deviations are appropriately documented. Maintain Architecture Decision Records for significant technical decisions. Provide architecture and design approval before major solutions move into production. 7. Stakeholder & Engineering Collaboration Conduct requirement and solutioning workshops with business and technology stakeholders. Understand how the data will ultimately be consumed before defining the underlying architecture. Work closely with Data Engineers throughout implementation to ensure approved designs are implemented correctly. Collaborate with business teams, application/source-system teams, reporting and analytics teams, AI teams, security, infrastructure and implementation partners. Ensure downstream requirements are understood early enough to influence ingestion, transformation and modeling decisions. Review implementations against the approved design and identify deviations or gaps. Communicate architecture decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Required Skills & Experience 812+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, Data Architecture or related areas. Demonstrated experience owning end-to-end enterprise data solution architecture. Strong architectural and hands-on knowledge of Snowflake and AWS. Strong understanding of Bronze/Silver/Gold Medallion Architecture. Advanced expertise in data modeling, including dimensional modeling, facts/dimensions, SCD, CDC and historization. Strong SQL skills and good working knowledge of Python. Strong understanding of ETL/ELT architecture, transformation frameworks and SQL-based data-processing patterns. Experience with Apache Airflow / Amazon MWAA or equivalent orchestration platforms. Strong understanding of data quality, reconciliation, error handling, observability, metadata and lineage. Understanding of designing governed and consumption-ready datasets for downstream reporting, analytics and AI workloads. Experience with enterprise security, RBAC, automated testing, CI/CD and production deployment controls. Strong understanding of cloud performance and cost optimization. 
 DATA SOLUTION ARCHITECT | JOB DESCRIPTION 
 Confidential • 4 
 Ability to evaluate multiple architectural alternatives and select the appropriate solution based on business and technical requirements. Strong stakeholder management and business-to-technology translation capabilities.

Key Skills: Database design,Snowflake,SQL,Data modeling,AWS,Data warehousing,Engineering,Data

title: Associate Solution Architect
description:
Job Title Associate Architect Role Purpose The Associate Architect is the junior-most architect role, responsible for providing technical ownership and architectural guidance for defined modules, components, or technical workstreams within a project. The role is expected to work closely with Technical/Solution Architects and engineering teams to translate architectural direction into implementable technical solutions, identify technical risks, ensure engineering quality, and contribute to successful technical delivery. The Associate Architect is expected to progressively develop from a technology-focused contributor into an independent technical owner. Key Responsibilities Solution & Architecture Understand functional and non-functional requirements for assigned modules/workstreams. Translate requirements into appropriate technical solutions within the defined architecture. Design components, services, APIs, integrations, data flows, and technical interfaces. Contribute to solution and architecture discussions. Ensure implementation follows defined architecture, standards, and design principles. Identify architectural gaps, dependencies, constraints, and technical risks within the assigned scope. Evaluate technology options and provide recommendations to senior architects. Technical Delivery Take technical ownership of assigned modules/workstreams from design through implementation. Support technical planning, estimation, sequencing, and dependency identification. Work closely with developers and QA engineers during implementation. Provide technical guidance and resolve technical issues within the assigned scope. Ensure technical decisions are documented and communicated to the relevant team members. Support technical readiness and release activities. Technical Quality Ensure code and implementation align with architectural and engineering standards. Promote clean code, maintainability, scalability, security, and performance. Support technical reviews, code reviews, and quality assessments. Identify technical debt and recommend appropriate remediation. Technical Risk Proactively identify technical risks and dependencies. Assess potential impact of technical risks on delivery. Propose mitigation approaches and escalate significant risks to the Technical/Solution Architect. Participate in root-cause analysis and resolution of technical issues. Technology & Engineering Maintain strong hands-on understanding of relevant technologies. Guide developers on appropriate technical implementation approaches. Evaluate new technologies and frameworks relevant to the project. Encourage automation and engineering best practices. AI Adoption & Governance Use approved AI tools to improve development, documentation, testing, analysis, and engineering productivity. Understand responsible AI practices and project-specific AI governance requirements. Ensure AI-generated code or technical outputs are reviewed and validated before adoption. Identify opportunities where AI can improve the assigned technical workstream. Presales Solutioning Support senior architects in technical solutioning activities. Contribute technical inputs to proposals, estimations, solution options, and feasibility assessments. Participate in technical discussions when required. Technical Competencies Strong programming fundamentals and hands-on development experience. Good understanding of software architecture and design principles. Knowledge of object-oriented design, design patterns, APIs, integration, databases, and distributed systems. Understanding of cloud platforms and modern application architecture. Understanding security, performance, scalability, and maintainability considerations. Familiarity with CI/CD and DevOps practices. Familiarity with automated testing and quality engineering practices. Awareness of AI-assisted software development and modern AI engineering tools. Good understanding of Agile software development practices. Behavioral Competencies Strong problem-solving ability. Analytical and structured thinking. Willingness to take ownership. Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly. Collaboration with developers, QA, DevOps, and senior architects. Curiosity and continuous learning mindset. Ability to challenge assumptions constructively. Ability to work independently within defined boundaries. Experience & Qualification Bachelors degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline. Typically, 5–8 years of relevant software engineering experience , with demonstrated exposure to architecture/design responsibilities. Strong hands-on technical background. Experience working on enterprise or complex software applications is preferred. 
 Interested candidates please share your updated resume on neelam.fernandes@straive.com. 
 Thanks & Regards, 
 Neelam Fernandes HR Team - Mumbai
